terminals.name: api
terminals.description: CallParity FastAPI engine on 127.0.0.1:8000. SQLite + Redis-optional + USE_FIXTURES=true, so no Docker, Postgres, Redis, or CALL-E credentials are required. Health: http://127.0.0.1:8000/healthz
